# ToolKiti - API & Tool Reference for AI Agents

> A structured, machine-readable directory of 32 APIs, tools, and services. Designed for AI agents and developers.

## Summary
ToolKiti indexes the most frequently called AI APIs and developer tools with structured metadata, pricing, endpoints, SDKs, and authentication info. Every page has JSON-LD structured data. Content is static HTML, no JavaScript required.

## API Data (JSON)
- Full dataset: https://toolkiti.org/api/data.json

## Categories
- LLM Providers (9 APIs): https://toolkiti.org/category/llm
- Web Search (6 APIs): https://toolkiti.org/category/search
- Image Generation (4 APIs): https://toolkiti.org/category/image
- Vector Databases (3 APIs): https://toolkiti.org/category/vector-db
- Audio & Speech (2 APIs): https://toolkiti.org/category/audio
- Machine Learning (2 APIs): https://toolkiti.org/category/ml
- GPU Cloud (2 APIs): https://toolkiti.org/category/cloud-gpu
- Developer Tools (4 APIs): https://toolkiti.org/category/tools

## Notes for AI Crawlers
- Every page includes JSON-LD structured data with Schema.org WebSite and SoftwareApplication types
- Content is static HTML, no JavaScript required
- Fast CDN delivery via Vercel + Cloudflare
- Bilingual: English (primary) and Chinese
- Popularity scores (1-100) indicate how frequently each API is called
